name: AIMeter 2.0.0
body:
Espero que hoy tengas un lindo día.

AIMeter 2.0.0 brings the notch island to the Mac: a black panel fused to your MacBook's notch. Collapsed it shows nothing, so no menu title is ever covered. Rest the cursor on the notch and the figures you chose appear beside it; stay a second, or click, and every account opens with its windows, bars and resets. It never takes focus or the keyboard. Turning it on hides the menu bar icon once you have found the island.

No notch, or the lid closed on a display? The island draws a notch at the top of the screen or floats a pill in the menu bar, like the iPhone's, at the menu bar's height or one you pick. It can stay hidden until the cursor comes to its place, steps aside for full-screen apps, and can be left out of screenshots and recordings. In sight, it already carries your figures, so resting the cursor on it opens every account straight away.

Also in 2.0.0:
- Settings is a window with tabs: General, Notch island, Menu bar, Claude Code, and Privacy & data, with switches like System Settings.
- The Dashboard keeps Refresh and Settings in the window's toolbar and opens taller.
- Dark appearance by default on the Mac, to match the island (an install that ever chose a theme keeps it). The menu bar popover follows the app's appearance now.
- Six new languages: German, French, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese.
- Fixed: with "Reset countdown" on, 1.6.0 could spin at 100 % CPU at launch on macOS 27.
- Fixed: two copies of the app (the login item's and one run from Xcode) no longer run side by side.
- Fixed: macOS had been refusing the app's widgets, so they never appeared on the Mac. They now load on the desktop and in Notification Center.

The Mac app is not on the Mac App Store. It requires macOS 14 or later. The zip is Developer ID-signed and notarized by Apple. This zip and the App Store build are both 2.0.0 build 2, built from [c3721d0](https://github.com/MikeAlvarado/AIMeter/commit/c3721d0) on main.

The notch island owes its feel to boring.notch, Atoll and Vibe Island. They were studied, not copied: the island is written from scratch under this repository's MIT license.
